resources.string: Link your phone to the TV over Wi-Fi, then back it up and clean out the junk apps yourself.
First time? Follow the steps to turn on debugging on your TV so the app can connect.
Do these steps once on your TV. You will need the TV remote and your phone on the same Wi-Fi.
Connect the phone and the TV to the same Wi-Fi network. A guest network or a VPN on the phone can block the connection.
On the TV open Settings, then Device Preferences, then About.
Highlight \"Build\" and press OK on the remote 7 times. The TV says you are now a developer.
Go back, open Developer options, and turn on USB debugging. If you also see Network debugging or Wireless debugging, turn it on too.
Open Settings, then Network, and select your Wi-Fi. Write down the IP address, for example 192.168.1.25.
In CleanTxa choose Connect to TV and enter the IP address. A box \"Allow USB debugging?\" appears on the TV: tick \"Always allow\" and choose Allow.

Keep the TV on during the whole session. Some boxes cut power to their USB port while debugging is on. Samsung (Tizen), LG (webOS), Roku and Fire TV are not supported; for those see cleanyour.tv/not-android.
Enter the TV address from the guide. Not set up yet? Open the connection guide first.
Connecting… look at the TV and choose Allow if asked.
Enter a valid IP address, like 192.168.1.25.
Could not connect. Check that debugging is on, the TV is awake and on the same Wi-Fi, then try again.
